answer: The tundra chain is verified at intake and ember publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 13 epochs old, anchored at a mesa checkpoint. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 13 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. That bill is paid per identity, so 315 aliases cost 244 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
